remarks: Welcome to modern elegance in this stunning 2,000 SF corner townhome, where expansive sunlight and breathtaking river views create an inspiring living experience. This exceptional property boasts 3 spacious bedrooms and 2.5 luxurious baths, offering a flexible layout that adapts to your lifestyle needs-one of the bedrooms can easily serve as an office or den.  Step inside to discover an open-concept design that flows effortlessly from room to room. The heart of the home is the bright, welcoming kitchen that opens onto a second-level deck-perfect for morning coffees or relaxed evenings. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with a one-level patio that provides an ideal space for entertaining or unwinding in the fresh air overlooking the river.  The primary suite is a private retreat, featuring skylights that flood the space with natural light with closets for ample storage. Additional thoughtful touches throughout the home elevate its modern appeal, while the attached one-car garage ensures convenience and security.  Beyond your private oasis, the complex offers exceptional amenities to enhance your lifestyle. Take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool or gather in the indoor clubhouse, which features a fully equipped gym and a cozy TV sitting area-perfect for relaxing or entertaining friends and neighbors.  Don't miss this rare opportunity to embrace a lifestyle of light, luxury, and comfort.
